shell_unchanged.interpretation: Storey outlines, levels, annex and roof parts identical to candidate_04; changes are interior and openings only.

window_retention.interpretation: Every candidate_04 window keeps identical vertices; owner space changes are expected re-hosting.

partitions_on_piers.interpretation: Inferred partitions meet the facade in window piers; no observed window is crossed.

continuous_spaces.interpretation: Only bottom/top horizontal boundaries: no intermediate slabs inside stair/core volumes.

roof_interfaces.interpretation: Roof-volume contacts must be open on both source sides and absent from physical display parts; exposed roof outside those contacts remains physical. Main-storey-to-roof contacts remain the explicitly inferred physical slab.

reachability.interpretation: Declared, partly inferred door/open-contact graph; not real-plan evidence.

dimensions.rule: every usable space has a part at least 2.4 m wide (corridors 2.0 m); narrower alcoves are listed, not failed
